_comment: Shared configuration, read by BOTH check-docs.ps1 and check_docs.py.
This file existing is what makes the two implementations comparable at all —
hardcoding the lists in each script guarantees they drift. Do not duplicate
any of this into either script.
enforced: files checked STRICTLY. Start every list EMPTY and add a file only
once it is already at 100%. A checker that reports hundreds of known misses
on its first run teaches everyone to ignore it.
Paths are repo-relative, forward slashes, on all platforms.
_not_yet_enforced_note: install.ps1/download-model.ps1/start-*.ps1 are PowerShell with no adapter yet; scripts/ and benchmark tooling deferred by scope decision 2026-08-19.
